अ-योग, अस्, m. separation, disjunction; interval;
unfitness, unsuitableness, unconformity; inefficacy of
a remedy; medical treatment counter to the symp-
toms; non-application or mis-application of re-
medies; vigorous effort, exertion; a widower, an
absent lover or husband; inauspicious conjunction of
the planets; a conjunction of two planets; (अस्, आ,
अम्), unconnected with; indistinctly connected with;
making vigorous efforts.
—अयोग-वाह, अस्, m. a
term for Anusvāra, Visarjanīya, Upadhmānīya, and
Jihvāmūlīya, as standing between vowels and conso-
nants. (For अयो-ग, hammer, see अयो-ऽग्र below.)

आ-योग, अस्, m. appointment; action, the perform-
ance of an act; presenting or offering flowers, per-
fumes, &c.; a shore or bank, a quay to which boats
are attached.

अ-योग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unfit, unsuitable, useless;
immaterial; (in phil.) not ascertainable &c. by the
senses.
—अयोग्य-ता, f. or अयोग्य-त्व, अम्, n. un-
fitness, unsuitableness.
अ-योजन, अम्, n. disunion, separation.

आ-योजन, अम्, n. effort, exertion; taking, seizing;
collecting.

अ-योद्धृ, धा, m. no warrior, a bad fighter;
unmatched by other warriors.
अयोद्धृ, अपयोध्य See अ-युद्ध, p. 79, last col.

अ-योध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not to be warred
against, irresistible; (आ), f. the capital of Rāma, the
modern Oude, on the river Sarayu.
—अयोध्याधि-
पति (˚या-अध्˚), इस्, m. the sovereign of Ayodhyā.
—अयोध्या-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, inhabiting Ayodhyā.

अयोगव अयोगव, अस्, आ, or ई, m. f. or अयो-
गू? (etymology uncertain; perhaps connected with
अयस्, iron, or fr. अ-योग), the offspring of a Śūdra
man and Vaiśya woman, whose business is carpentry.
See आयोगव.

आयोगव आयोगव, अस्, m. a man belonging
to the tribe of Ayogu; a man of a mixed tribe sprung
from a Śūdra man and Vaiśya woman; his business
is carpentry &c.; (ई), f. a woman of this tribe.

अयोगुड अयो-गुड, अस्, m. (अयो for अयस्,
iron), a chalybeate pill, one made of some prepara-
tion of iron; an iron ball.

अयो-ऽग्र or अयो-ऽग्रक (अयस्-अग्˚), अम्, n. a
hammer, a forge hammer; a mace or club tipped
with iron; a pestle for cleaning grain. (A form
अयो-ग, अस्, m., is also given in the sense ‘iron
hammer.’)
अयो-घन, अस्, m. a hammer, a forge hammer.
अयोच्छिष्ट (अयस्-उच्˚?), अम्, n. rust of iron.

अयो-जाल, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with iron nets;
(अम्), n. iron net-work.

अयो-दंष्ट्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved., or अयो-दत्, अत्,
अती, अत्, iron-toothed, having iron weapons.
अयो-दाह, अस्, m. the burning quality of iron.

अयो-ऽपाष्टि (अयस्-अप्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. furnished
with iron claws or heels.

अयो-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of iron. See also
s.v. अयस्.
अयो-मल, अम्, n. rust of iron.

अयो-मुख, अस्, आ, अम्, having an iron mouth,
face, or beak; tipped or pointed with iron; (अस्), m.
an arrow; N. of a Dānava; N. of a mountain.
अयो-रज, अम्, n. or अयो-रजस्, अस्, n. rust of iron.
अयो-रस, अस्, m. iron rust or filings.
अयो-वत्स, अस्, m., N. of a man.
अयो-विकार, अस्, m. iron-work, any iron fabric.
अयो-हनु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. iron-jawed.

अयो-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, iron-hearted, stern, un-
relenting.

अयोनि अ-योनि, इस्, f. not the womb; any-
thing but the womb; not a particular verse of the
Sāma-veda; (इस्, इस्, इ), without origin; not born
from the womb, born in a manner not approved by
law or religion; (इस्), m., N. of Brahmā and Śiva; a
pestle (for अयो-ऽग्र above ?).
—अ-योनि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्,
not born from the womb, not produced in the or-
dinary course of generation, generated equivocally;
(अम्), n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—अयोनिज-त्व, अम्, n. the
state of not being born from a womb. -अयोनिजेश
(˚ज-ईश˚), अस्, m., N. of Śiva.
—अयोनिजेश्वर (˚ज-
ईश्˚) or अयोनिजेश्वर-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—अ-योनि-सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम् = अयोनिज, q. v.

अ-योनिक, अस्, आ, अम्, without the verse containing
the word योनि.
आ-योजित, अस्, आ, अम्, collected together.

आ-योधन, अम्, n. war, battle; slaughter, killing;
battle-field.
आयोद आयोद, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
